text: What actually distinguishes an analog signal from a digital one?
choices: Analog signals are smooth waves; digital signals are square
Whether the set of meaningful values is continuous or discrete — a property of the agreement, not of the waveform
Analog signals carry voice; digital signals carry data
Digital signals are immune to noise
explanation: Every signal on every wire is a continuous physical quantity. What makes one digital is an agreement that only a discrete set of values is meaningful, which is what permits perfect regeneration rather than amplification of accumulated noise.
